name: TOB Festival Theme
description: Festival looks for the app's Home and truthofbible.org (Christmas, Easter, Pentecost, …): a moving scene with a greeting and a verse, shown from Start to End when it is On. The master switch is TOB Website Settings → Festival Themes (Off / Admins only / Everyone). Read by truth_of_bible.api.website.festival_theme.

fields.label: On
fields.description: Off = never shown, whatever the dates.

fields.label: Scene
fields.options:
Advent
Christmas
New Year
Palm Sunday
Good Friday
Easter
Ascension
Pentecost
Harvest Thanksgiving
fields.description: The moving picture behind the greeting. Good Friday is quiet on purpose: no celebration effects.

fields.label: Start
fields.description: India time. Phones switch it on by themselves at this moment, even offline.

fields.label: End
fields.description: India time. The normal look returns by itself.

fields.label: Opening Moment in the App
fields.description: The first time the app opens during the festival: the scene full-screen with the greeting for a few seconds (tap to skip). Once per festival.

fields.label: Show on truthofbible.org
fields.description: The scene behind the home page's top and a greeting ribbon on every page.

fields.label: Motion
fields.description: How much moves (snow, light, petals). People can still turn motion off for themselves, and phones that ask for reduced motion get a still picture.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: One short line under the greeting (optional).

fields.label: Verse
fields.description: Shown in each reader's own Bible, so only the place is stored here.

fields.label: Verse To
fields.description: Same as Verse From for one verse.
